title: Good Morning, Sunshine!
subtitle: Morning Routine Song for Kids
theme: waking up, brushing teeth, eating breakfast

lines: The sun is peeking through my window,
Time to wake up, sleepy head!
Stretch up high and wiggle your toes,
Hop, hop, hop right out of bed!
Good morning, good morning, hello to the day!
Good morning, good morning, let's laugh and play!
With a yawn and a stretch and a great big smile,
Good morning, sunshine, stay a while!
Brush, brush, brush my teeth so bright,
Up and down and left and right,
Splash my face and comb my hair,
Bubbles, bubbles everywhere!
Good morning, good morning, hello to the day!
Good morning, good morning, let's laugh and play!
With a yawn and a stretch and a great big smile,
Good morning, sunshine, stay a while!
Pancakes, berries, milk for me,
Yummy, yummy, one, two, three!
Say thank you and clean my plate,
A brand new day, I just can't wait!
Good morning, good morning, hello to the day!
Good morning, good morning, let's laugh and play!
With a yawn and a stretch and a great big smile,
Good morning, sunshine, stay a while!
Shirt goes on and pants go too,
Socks and then my bright red shoes!
Zip my jacket, snug and tight,
Look at me, I'm dressed just right!
Good morning, good morning, hello to the day!
Good morning, good morning, let's laugh and play!
With a yawn and a stretch and a great big smile,
Good morning, sunshine, stay a while!
Grab my backpack, hug goodbye,
Wave to Grandpa, way up high!
Hop on the bus and off we go,
Sunshine smiling, don't you know!
Good morning, good morning, hello to the day!
Good morning, good morning, let's laugh and play!
With a yawn and a stretch and a great big smile,
Good morning, sunshine, stay a while!

seo.hook: Rise and shine! ☀️ Wake up, stretch, brush your teeth and eat breakfast with Lily, Leo and Pip in this happy morning routine song for kids.
seo.summary: Good Morning, Sunshine! is an original morning routine song that turns getting ready into a fun sing-along.

shots.desc: Lily e Leo dançam no quarto
Dança com bolhas de sabão na casa de banho
Pequeno-almoço com panquecas e o Pip
Mochila, abraço e adeus ao avô à porta
Grande dança final no parque com amigos
